sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:30

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:30:1
items.html: Its Histaklut, Reiah and Habata in the Ohr Akudim, called the above mentioned Nefesh. The Peh de Rosh is called Nefesh. The Hitpashtut Ohr is called Histaklut and Habata. Hence, the Hitpashtut Ohr Elyon to the Masach in Kli Malchut for Zivug de Hakaa is called Histaklut and Habata in the Nefesh, meaning the Masach in Malchut.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:30:2
items.html: The emanator, He sees and looks at the Nefesh, called “the”. As has been written in the previous item, the Masach in Kli Malchut is called Nefesh and is called “the”, as the Rav has written, and examine carefully (Part 3, Chap 3 item 3).
